title: Create Slide Guide Grid (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Create Slide Guide Grid applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Create Slide Guide Grid (BtnSlideGuidelines) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Create Slide Guidelines adds the measured default-layout guideline shapes in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Create Slide Guidelines with the Default layout on an empty slide adds exactly 8 guideline shapes (measured delta=8 from 0 to 8), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
